- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 01:18
- [USER] User inquired about where to find environmental engineering datasets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) - offers a wide range of datasets related to climate, weather, and oceanography.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - provides datasets on air and water quality, hazardous waste, and other environmental topics.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] United States Geological Survey (USGS) - offers datasets on water resources, geology, and natural hazards.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Data.gov - a government-run website that provides access to a wide variety of datasets from various federal agencies, including those related to the environment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] World Bank - provides datasets on various environmental and development topics, including water and sanitation, air pollution, and climate change.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kaggle - is a website that hosts a variety of datasets, including those related to environmental engineering and science.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There are many other sources available on the internet that can be found with a little more research.
